meanings: language, a system of words people use to communicate

etymology.text: From Old French langage, from langue 'tongue', which comes from Latin lingua; it came into Middle English around 1300.

simple-translation: the words people use to talk and write

core.key: اللغات هي الجسور التي تربط الناس بالعالم.
core.romanization: al-lughāt hiya al-jusūr allatī tarbiṭ al-nās bi-l-ʿālam
meanings: Languages are the bridges that connect people to the world.

examples.sentence: المكتبات هي الجسور التي تربط القارئ بالمعرفة.
examples.translation: Libraries are the bridges that connect the reader to knowledge.

pronunciation: Languages are the bridges that connect people to the world.
simple-translation: Languages help people understand each other and the world.
